title: DELICIOUS BREAKFAST DISH
instructions: Take some hog meat prepared for sausages. Chop up some well boiled pig's feet, mix with it, and wrap up in a lace. Fry it, and serve hot. --MME. ALZIRE DUBROCA, Baton Rouge.
